query:
UPDATE images
            SET ai_image_type = $2,
                ai_room = $3,
                ai_condition = $4,
                ai_confidence = $5,
                ai_issues = $6,
                ai_description = $7,
                ai_model = $8,
                ai_analyzed_at = NOW(), ai_retry_at = NULL, ai_last_error = NULL
            WHERE id = $1
